## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Privacy and permissions

- [ ] No new data collection, transfer, analytics, tracking, remote code, or required host access.
- [ ] Any permission or data-handling change is documented and justified.
- [ ] Examples, logs, screenshots, and tests contain no real phone numbers or personal/confidential data.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run pack:core`
- [ ] Manual Chrome testing when extension behavior changed
